batchuserrights-desc: Waxay oggolaanaysaa in hal ama in ka badan oo isticmaalayaal ah lagu daro hal ama in ka badan oo kooxo ah hal ficil
batchuserrights-names: Magacyada isticmaalayaasha kooxdan lagu darayo (mid sadar kasta):
batchuserrights-intro:
Boggan wuxuu kuu oggolaanayaa inaad koox ku darto isticmaalayaal badan hal mar.
Sababo amni awgood, liiska kooxaha lagu dari karo waxaa lagu dejiyay qaabeynta kordhinta, mana laga beddeli karo gudaha wiki-ga.
Fadlan la xiriir maamulaha nidaamka haddii aad u baahan tahay in loo oggolaado ku-darista dufcad ahaan ee kooxo kale.
batchuserrights-add-groups: Waxaa {{PLURAL:$1|hal isticmaale|$1 isticmaale}} lagu darayaa {{PLURAL:$2|kooxda|kooxaha}} soo socda: $3.
batchuserrights-no-groups:
Ma dooran wax kooxo ah.
Tani waxba ma qaban doonto.
Qaybta inteeda kale ee bogga waa la oggolaan doonaa inay socoto si aad si fudud u arki karto haddii qaar ka mid ah magacyada isticmaalayaasha aan la soo dejin karin.
right-batchuserrights: Hal ama in ka badan oo isticmaalayaal ah ku dar koox ama kooxo badan hal ficil
action-batchuserrights: ku dar hal ama in ka badan oo isticmaalayaal ah koox ama kooxo badan hal ficil
